tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa mchod pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i ngag 'don skal ba bzang po'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas gtsug bsten nas// skye ba 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// dge legs 'byung gnas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// ngag 'don skal ba bzang po'i mgul rgyan bstar// 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa khrid gzhung gis dngos bstan nyams su len pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rkyang pa byed na mchod pa bsham 'don ma byung yang rung la/ bla ma mchod pa byed na/ maṇḍal dang mchod pa rnams spyi ltar bshams la/ gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin rlabs dharma ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i bar dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ci nus bya/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*// rin chen las grub seng ge'i khri// sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i steng*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon// drin chen bla ma chos kyi rje// rnam pa rdo rje 'jigs byed sku// rtsa zhal ma he khros pa ste// zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum// g.yon brkyang rnam par 'gying bas bzhugs// chags can 'dul ba'i mtshan ma bsgreng*// khro bo'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan// phung po dbyings bcas rgyal ba drug /khams lnga yum dang skye mched drug /yul drug sems dpa' sems ma dang*// yan lag tshigs rnams khro bo bcu// kun 'dus bdag nyid de mthar yang*// bla ma rgyal ba sras slob dang*// bstan srung nor lhas bskor bar gyur// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs// spyan drangs dbyer med thim par gyur// de la mos gus rtse gcig pas// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs// 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad// nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*// me shel med par me mi 'byung*// de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*// bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur// des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i// bla ma khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter// dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma de la 'dud// khyod ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga// khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston// spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang*// nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel// byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams// mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs khro bo bcu// dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha// gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston// nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mkhyen// thams cad spro ba'i phrin las kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul// gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yis// sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang*// bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// khyod kyi phrin las ngo mtshar rmad// gang gis g.yo med khyod bsten pa// de la de ma thag byin rlabs// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang na phun tshogs thams cad 'grub// des na rdo rje slob dpon mchog

/dngos po kun gyis de la 'dud// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// lus dang longs spyod 'brel pa kun// srog gi bar gyis khyod mnyes bgyi// ji srid rnam par grol ba'i sa// bdag gzhan kun gyis ma thob bar// de srid mchod pa mchog gi sprin// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las// ches lhag gyur pas khyod mchod do// khyod ni gang la mnyes gyur pa'i// phrin las de nyid sgrub par shog /mi mnyes byed pa rnam spangs te// rnam pa kun tu khyod bsten no// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub slad du// mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na// gal te bla na med pa yi// byang chub thob kyang de dor te// skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang thob par shog /ces dang spro na/ sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas dges pa'i tshul khrims ldan// gsung gi phrin las phun sum tshogs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab// thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pas// chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen// mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'// sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i// phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje// khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed// bsten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur// bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad// bsnyen bkur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung*// de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje// bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs// mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni// bla ma mchod pa bya'o zhes// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// de bas dngos po thams cad kyis// bla ma mnyes pa byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar// de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du// 'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig

/mchod pa kun gyis mchod byed cing*// dam chos rtag tu mnyan pa dang*// bka' bzhin sgrub pa byed par shog /ces dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dang gshin rje'i gshed// ces sogs nas/ kun dga' bzang po paṇḍi ta// zhes pa'i bar phrin las char 'bebs nang mchod 'bul skabs ltar brjod/ de nas/ legs 'byung sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// sa skya lo tsā lha mchog pa// dkon mchog lhun grub sangs rgyas seng*// dkon mchog dpal ldan brang ti pa// kun dga' bkra shis dpal grub mtshan// sher 'byung nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs// dam chos bsam 'grub buddha'i mtshan// phrin las rgya mtsho tshul khrims lhun/

bstan lhun dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen rje// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// gshin rje'i gshed sogs yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ces dbang gi brgyud pa'am khrid kyi brgyud pa gang rung gis gsol ba btab mthar/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs pa ni// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar bar dang mthar dge zhing*// rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam// dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing*// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gnas// bde gshegs bstan pa legs 'dzin pa'i// bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun du// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// bar dang*/ yid las byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig

/de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mchod yon phal cher sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru badzra bhai ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ oṃ badzra lā sya sogs sgeg sogs brgyad dang bcas pas mchod/ bsdu na tshigs bcad dor ba'i sngags tsam gyis kyang chog go /nang mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// gsang gsum yon tan phrin las bdag /mkhyen brtse nus gter bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du mchod// gshin rje'i gshed kyi zhal du mchod// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du mchod// gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi yi lha sogs nas// phrin las sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// ces dang*/ de nas maṇḍal tshom bu bdun pa gtso bor 'bul zhing mjug gi gsol gdab spyi ltar dang*/ skabs 'gar bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tha mal rnam rtog spang bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ snang ba lha ru 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gyur med bde chen rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang bzhin lhan skyes skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yang dag ye shes skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim gnyis yon tan rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ maṇḍal so bdun ma dang*/ gong gis mchod rdzas sogs kyang byas la/ phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad dang*// mchod 'os kun la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag bgyir 'os pa de dag la'ang*// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod// nongs par spyad pa gang lags pa// de kun so sor bshags par 'tshal// dge dang dge ba'i 'bras bu'i tshogs// kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*// rgyal ba kun la theg mchog gi

/'khor lo rin chen bskor ba bskul// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas thugs rje rab khros pa// rdo rje khro bor gyur rnams la// gdug pa 'dul phyir mngon spyod kyi// las la rtag tu bskul bar bgyi// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// ma lus blo yis bsdams byas nas// sems can kun gyi don dag tu// rdo rje khro bor 'gyur bar shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las kun// bsgrub phyir phrin las sna tshogs pa'i// lus dang sprul par bdag gyur nas// phrin las ma lus sgrub par shog /sras bcas rgyal ba'i phrin las kyis// kun nas 'dul bar mi spyod pa'i// gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo yi// stobs kyi dbang por bdag gyur cig /tshe 'dir gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kyi// bsam sbyor gdug pa nyer zhi nas// lhag bsam dge ba'i sbyor ba yis// bdag gzhan don kun sgrub par shog /tshe ring ba dang nad med dang*// dpal dang 'byor pa phun tshogs pas// bstan dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// rtsa lag dam pa byed par shog /ces pa dang*/ spro zhing nus na phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs tshig lhug pas kyang gsol ba gdab pa'i mthar/ mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs// dbyings kyi rol pas bla mar thim// bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge las// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum ni// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi gzugs su byung*// bdag gi sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs// bla ma rang gi gtsug nas thim// sku gsung thugs sogs dbyer med 'dres// zhes bsams shing dad mos rtse gcig pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed par gnas lugs don gyi bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi rang zhal mthong ba na/ de'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag mthar/ thos pa rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ skye ba kun tu sogs brjod cing*/ gnas skabs thams cad bla ma'i yon tan dran pas bstod pa 'don pa sogs la 'bad par bya'o// zhes dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i lam gyi dngos gzhir yang 'gyur ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa mchod pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa'i ngag 'don skal ba bzang po'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/

don gnyer gyi ngor rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gzhung las 'byung ba nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul rin du bod pas bris pa 'gro ba'i rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms ma'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs ba zhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ thub pa'i dbang po bcom ldan zas gtsang sras// gsang ba'i bdag po rab gsal zla ba dang*// sgra gcan 'dzin dpal kun dga' snying po'i zhabs// shes rab bskyangs dang pradzñā bo dhi pa// mukti ko ṣa dharma pā la dang*// dī paṃ ka ra go mi sgom chen zhabs// skyi nor dzñā na gnyal pa nyi she dang*// snur chen nyi 'od de sras rdo rje seng*// byang chub 'od dang nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa// ye shes rgyal mtshan chos 'phags rgyal mtshan zhabs// kun mkhyen 'phags 'od bu ston rin po che// rgyal mtshan grags pa bkra shis rin chen dang*// kun dga' bzang po mus chen sems dpa' che// sangs rgyas rin chen sangs rgyas seng ge dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang dpal ldan don kun grub// shes rab 'byung gnas lhun grub bkra shis dang*// kun dga' legs pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// kun dga' bstan 'dzin tshul khrims rin yang na/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub bkra shis lhun gyis grub// tshul rin la sogs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sogs sbrel/ chen sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das// 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe rabs ring mo nas// tshe thung 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa// mkhyen brtse nus pa chen pos sbyang du gsol// bdag sogs mar gyur mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// 'chi bdag chad pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas// tshe dang las bzang bsod nams ye shes rgyas// mthar thug kun mkhyen thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad par chad 'dzud kha 'gengs dang bcas 'di mkhar mdo dbu mdzad ngag dbang bsod nams pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/

bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis zhus dag gi tshul du bgyis pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༄༅// thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs gtsor smos kyi bla ma yi dam kun 'dus la gsol ba 'debs pa dkon mchog thugs rje bskul ba'i 'phrin yig ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma// grub dbang tshem bu pa dang spyi lhas pa/ byang chub 'od/ /byang brag dmar ba/ chub tshul khrims dgon gsar ba/ bsod nams snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// jo nang kun thugs rje brtson 'grus/ spangs rgyal ba ye shes pa// gzhon nu seng ge bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// kun dga' bkra shis thugs sras dpal ldan legs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan rdo rings pa// nam mkha'i mtshan can tshar chen chos kyi rje// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// ngag dbang chos grags rgyal rtse bsod nams mtshan// sangs rgyas dpal bzang sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// kun dga' bstan 'dzin buddha shrī bha drar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam kun 'dus bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// bar chad kun sel bstan srung nor lhar bcas// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sngon 'gro dam chos sgrub rten dal 'byor lus// rnyed dka' 'jigs par sla ba'i tshul shes nas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gnas su ma chags par// sdig spangs dge ba sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// bslu med skyabs yul bla ma dkon mchog gsum// deng nas byang chub bar gyi skyabs su gzung*// mar gyur 'gro ba sdug bsngal las gdon phyir// byang chub sems gnyis 'byong par byin gyis rlobs// rdor sems bdud rtsis sdig sgrib nyes ltung sbyong*// rje btsun bla mas dus gsum bde gshegs kyi// yon tan mtha' dag bdag rgyud smin mdzad cing*// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// dngos gzhi skye 'chi bar do'i rnam par rtog

/sbyong byed bskyed dang rdzogs pa zung 'jug gi /rnal 'byor bsgom pas sangs rgyas chos gzugs kyi// yon tan rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge drug pa'i sgra// skye 'gag bral ba brag ca'i bzlas brjod kyis// yi dam zhi khro'i rnam rol grangs med kyi// zhal mthong dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rjes thob snod bcud gzhal med khang dang lha// sgra skad thams cad grag stong sngags kyi gdangs// dran bsam rig stong dbyer med ye shes su// lam 'khyer dag snang 'byong par byin gyis rlobs// zas gos gnas mal gnyid du mur ba rnams// tha mal bden zhen 'ching ba las grol ba'i// sgyu ma'i skyes bus rtse 'jor rol pa ltar// lam gyi yon tan bskyed rgyur byin gyis rlobs// nam zhig 'chi tshe lus sems zug rngu bral// bla ma yi dam lha dang rang sems gsum// dbyer med 'phos pas mkha' 'gro'i dbang po ltar// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// gal te de tshe 'phos par ma gyur na// rnam shes 'od gsal la thim stong gsal gyi// ting 'dzin skye ba 'chi ba chos kyi sku'i// rang zhal ma bu mjal bar byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal las ldang bar dor 'khrul gyur na// cir snang lha sngags ye shes bsgyur ba'i 'phral// rnam grol longs sku grub pa'i phrin las kyis// mkha' mnyam 'gror phan byed por nyid byin rlabs// mdor na kun 'dus bdag nyid bla ma lhas// rjes su bzung nas po tā la ri dang*// bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing bgrod cing*// 'gro ba rgya mtsho smin par byed par shog /gsol 'debs brtson pa'i 'phrin yig snyan pa'i sgras// dkon mchog thugs rje'i skyed byed bskul ba'i mod// bden tshig grub pa'i yid dga'i mdza' na mo// mngon 'dod khang bur ring min khugs par shog /ces thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshem bu lugs gtsor smos kyi bla ma yi dam kun 'dus la gsol ba 'debs pa dkon mchog thugs rje bskul ba'i 'phrin yig ces bya ba 'di ni/

gnam bskos sa skyong bla ma'i mdun na 'don pa dge slong tshul khrims rab brtan pa'i zhal 'don du bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa'o// ༈ //nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor ni// snying gar yi dam chung ngu dang*// spyi bor bla ma kun 'dus gsal// de la gsol ba 'di ltar gdab// bla ma 'od dpag med mgon bdag /rmi lam mang po rmi ba dang*// rmi lam rmi lam shes nas de'ang*// 'od gsal rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma snying ga'i yi dam gyi// gtsug tu byon pa'i 'od zer gyis// yas mar gsal res ngang du nyal// 'di la goms na sprul bsgyur gyis// sangs rgyas zhing mang bgrod rgyur gsungs// 'di yang 'di la dgos ched bris// // ༄// mgon dkar rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang chen sha ba ri dbang phyug /mai tri pa dang sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa// khyung po rnal 'byor rin chen brtson 'grus dang*// skyer sgang chos seng gnyan ston rnal 'byor zhabs// sangs rgyas ston pa mkhas grub gtsang pa shangs// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bla ma rdor gzhon mtshan// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor byang sems sbyin pa bzang*// thang stong rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan dar po zhi dgon bsod nams rtse// 'gyur med bde chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags// rgyal brtse bkra shis dpal ldan buddha'i mtshan// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// dpal ldan chos skyong rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// dngos brgyud bla ma mgon dkar yid bzhin nor// 'khor dang bcas la rtse gcig gsol 'debs kyis// dpal 'byor phrin las rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// stobs 'byor blo ldan skye 'gro longs spyod bcas// bdag gis dbang bsdus chos dang srid pa'i dpal// 'dzad med gter la dbang 'byor rgyal bstan dang*// 'gror phan phrin las rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces mgon dkar rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub dbyig gter 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dbon stod chos rje'i gsung ma bzlog tsam du/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bsten pa'i lha// gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// 'khor bcas mchod pas mnyes gyur nas// brtsams don 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// byang chub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rten// ring 'tshor bgyid pa'i sman dpyad sogs// phan byed kun gyi mthu nus dpal// nyams med rdo rje ltar skyed cig /tshe ring nad med dga' bde'i dpal// mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan pas// mkhas tshul gsum gyis stobs bcu pa'i// phrin las kun du rgyas par mdzod// ces 'dod gsol nyung ngu 'di'ang dgos skabs shig tu tshul rin rang gis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
